candidates.original_title: Understanding information systems continuance: an expectation-confirmation model
candidates.description: IS Continuance Model predicting continuance intention from satisfaction, confirmation, and perceived usefulness in web-based banking.
candidates.citation_sentence: [3] published one of the earliest and most cited scholarly papers in the IS field that conceptualizes and tests a theoretical model of IT continuance that takes into account the distinctions between adoption and continued use of IT.
candidates.notes: The paper's body identifies the original study only by reference number [3]; the author name and year appear only in the reference list, which is used as the citation_sentence.
